audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls his grenade 'CH-3X' in six places. Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat at every rank, 970 range, stun on direct hit, slow around it). The page also claims Smoke Screen 'blinds the turret beams' in five places — the W applies no blind at all, and turret beams are not autos.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name plus a blind that does not exist is the exact failure the calibration list names. A player told to smoke the turrets and stand in the nest dies to the beams.
audit.corrected: Every CH-3X renamed to CH-2, with its real 11s cooldown given as the commit trigger. Smoke Screen restated as a sight-range cut plus impact damage and a brief slow — it hides YOU, it does not disable his hardware.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Skill, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger while the whys give Level 1 to him outright ('you literally cannot reach him'), call Level 2 a dodging contest, hand Level 3 and Level 6 to you, and call first item 'your peak duel power'. Packet chart is Heimerdinger, Skill, Graves, Skill, Graves, Graves, Heimerdinger.
audit.why: Five of seven rows disagreed with the page's own text and with the packet.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group to Heimerdinger, Skill, Graves, Skill, Graves, Graves, Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger rows at 3/10, Graves rows at 6/10, even rows 5/10, with five phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first item were shown as neutral/his. Collateral Damage (100/80/60s, 1000 range) nukes past the turret zone and is your cleanest kill button, and Eclipse/Youmuu's is your duel peak before Liandry's burn arrives.
audit.why: His spikes are turret ranks and AP items, not levels — the level spikes belong to you.
audit.corrected: phases[4] and phases[5] restated to Graves, with the grenade's 11s cooldown as the window that makes the dive safe.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: He plants a turret and rockets you while you hold one ability and no dash — you cannot reach him.

edits.before: E online — dash-reload weaving starts: auto, E for the grit armor and reset, auto again. Most champs lose this flat.
edits.after: Second ability up, but the turret zone still out-pokes a Graves who only steps in to last-hit. Dodge and farm.

edits.before: Full kit: Q's wall-bounce return is your real damage — fight near terrain so both hits connect.
edits.after: Level 3: E across the turret line, fog his sight, and burst him before the CH-2 grenade returns.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Collateral Damage nukes past the turret zone — fire it on his 11s grenade cooldown, never into it.

edits.before: First item spike — the point-blank Q-AA-E-AA pattern now removes half bars. Force fights near walls.
edits.after: First item is your peak duel power — you blow him up faster than the turrets punish the dive.

edits.before: With Q, E and W online you dash the turret line, W-blind the beams and his vision, and burst him before his next CH-3X grenade lands.
edits.after: With Q, E and W online you dash the turret line, fog his sight so his aim goes, and burst him before the next CH-2 grenade lands on 11s.

edits.before: With Q powder-trail, your E dash and W smoke online, you can finally cross the turret line: E in, W-smoke to blind the turret beams and cut his sightline, then Q-detonation plus point-blank shells before his next CH-3X grenade lands.
edits.after: With Q powder-trail, your E dash and W smoke online, you can finally cross the turret line: E in, W-smoke to cut his sightline (it never blinds the beams), then Q-detonation plus point-blank shells before his next CH-2 grenade lands on 11s.

edits.before: Collateral Damage is your kill button. Fire R through him or at the wall behind him to nuke past the turret zone, but commit on his E-grenade cooldown so he can't stun you mid-dive.
edits.after: Collateral Damage is your kill button. Fire R through him or at the wall behind him to nuke past the turret zone, but commit on the CH-2 grenade's 11s cooldown so he can't stun you mid-dive.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are his. He plants an H-28G turret on the wave and his Hextech Micro-Rockets chip you every time you walk up to last-hit, and with only your Q (no E dash yet) you can't close the gap to trade back. Farm at max Q range, eat a little poke, and don't burn Q trying to kill his turret early. Everything flips at Level 3: now you have E to dash the turret line, W-smoke to blind the turret beams and slash his vision, and Q to burst — that's your first real all-in window.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are his. He plants an H-28G turret on the wave and his Hextech Micro-Rockets chip you every time you walk up to last-hit, and with only your Q (no E dash yet) you can't close the gap to trade back. Farm at max Q range, eat a little poke, and don't burn Q trying to kill his turret early. Everything flips at Level 3: now you have E to dash the turret line, W-smoke to cut his vision (the beams are hardware, never blinded), and Q to burst — your first real all-in window.

edits.before: This is where you take over. Bait his CH-3X stun grenade — it's his only hard CC and the whole fight hinges on it — then E across the turrets, W-smoke to blind their beams and cut his sightline, and your Q-detonation plus point-blank shells melt him. At 6, R is your kill button: fire it through him or at the wall behind him to nuke past the turret zone while his grenade is on cooldown. His turrets out-DPS you if you sit in the beams, so commit only when you can reach HIM, not his hardware.
edits.after: This is where you take over. Bait his CH-2 stun grenade — 11s flat, his only hard CC, and the whole fight hinges on it — then E across the turrets, W-smoke to cut his sightline, and your Q-detonation plus point-blank shells melt him. At 6, R is your kill button: fire it through him or at the wall behind him to nuke past the turret zone in that 11s window. His turrets out-DPS you if you sit in the beams, so commit only when you can reach HIM, not his hardware.

edits.after: Hit Level 3, then E-dash across the turret line and W-smoke to shrink his vision — it never blinds the beams — before your Q burst

edits.before: Bait the CH-3X stun grenade, then E in and R him (or the wall behind him) for the lethal burst while his only hard CC is down
edits.after: Bait the CH-2 stun grenade (11s), then E in and R him (or the wall behind him) for the lethal burst while his only hard CC is down

edits.before: Land the CH-3X stun grenade to lock you in the turret crossfire before you can E out
edits.after: Land the CH-2 stun grenade to lock you in the turret crossfire before you can E out

edits.before: Your W smoke blinds tower dives and breaks gank pathing — drop it on arrival and turn their 2v1 into a coin flip you win.
edits.after: Smoke Screen cuts sight and slows on impact — no blind. Drop it as the gank arrives and fight them blind-sided in the fog.

notes: Fabricated ability name killed: the page said 'CH-3X grenade' six times — Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat at all ranks, and that timer is now the page's commit trigger. Smoke Screen 'blinds the turret beams' removed in five places; the W is a sight cut plus brief slow and does nothing to turrets. Level chart flipped to the packet chart, which the page's own whys already described. No mirror audit exists for heimerdinger__graves — these facts should be restated inverted when it is written: Heimer owns Level 1 and 2+ items, Graves owns Level 3, Level 6 and first item.
